header: Test vectors for Ascon-AEAD128 standardized in NIST SP 800-232.
These vectors are not compatible with the pre-standardization Ascon-128a v1.2 algorithm.

ByteOrder.description: Nonzero bytes at distinct key and nonce positions detect incorrect byte ordering.

BytePattern.description: Structured byte patterns exercise byte ordering and state insertion.

Ktv.description: Known-answer test from the ascon-c reference implementation.

ModifiedCiphertext.description: Exactly one ciphertext bit was changed.

ModifiedInput.description: Exactly one key, nonce, or associated-data bit was changed.

ModifiedTag.description: Exactly one authentication-tag bit was changed.

Pseudorandom.description: Deterministic pseudorandom inputs covering a range of lengths.

RateBoundary.description: Lengths around the 8-byte word and 16-byte rate boundaries.

tests.comment: NIST/ascon-c known-answer test, empty AAD and plaintext
